name: container-terminal
title: Container Terminal
description: Search Podman, Docker and Distrobox containers and open the selected one in Ghostty or another terminal.
author: HuntedRaven7

commands.name: containers
commands.title: Open Container in Terminal
commands.description: Search containers from every enabled runtime and open a shell in the selected one.

preferences.name: enablePodman
preferences.title: Container runtimes
preferences.label: Podman
preferences.description: Include containers managed by Podman in the search results.

preferences.name: enableDocker
preferences.label: Docker
preferences.description: Include containers managed by Docker in the search results.

preferences.name: enableDistrobox
preferences.label: Distrobox
preferences.description: Include Distrobox containers in the search results.

preferences.name: includeStopped
preferences.title: Containers
preferences.label: Include stopped containers
preferences.description: Show stopped containers too. A stopped container is started before its shell opens.

preferences.name: terminal
preferences.title: Terminal emulator
preferences.description: The terminal used to open the container shell. {command} is replaced with the shell command.

preferences.name: customTerminalTemplate
preferences.title: Custom terminal command
preferences.description: Used when the terminal emulator is set to Custom command. Include {command} where the shell command belongs.

preferences.name: containerShell
preferences.title: Shell inside containers
preferences.description: The shell started inside Podman and Docker containers. Distrobox uses its own entry command.
